title: Morin enhances the renoprotective effects of Empagliflozin in diabetic kidney disease via targeting ATF6-DAPK1 signaling.
authors: Lei, Yi; Gao, Chenlin; Zhao, Xin; Huang, Wei; Jiang, Chunxia; Wu, Qi; Law, Betty Yuen Kwan; Xu, Yong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Morin与Empagliflozin对糖尿病肾病的保护作用，涉及ATF6-DAPK1信号及小分子-蛋白对接，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) is a major complication of diabetes mellitus, driven by hyperglycemia-induced oxidative stress, ER stress, and mitochondrial apoptosis. This study examined the protective effects of Morin against hyperglycemia-induced renal tubular injury, alone or in combination with the SGLT2 inhibitor Empagliflozin, with emphasis on the ATF6-DAPK1 axis. HK2 cells were exposed to high glucose with or without Morin and/or Empagliflozin. Cellular stress, mitochondrial function, and apoptosis were assessed. Morin-DAPK1 binding was examined via molecular docking, surface plasmon resonance (SPR), and cell thermal shift assay (CETSA). db/db mice received vehicle, Empagliflozin, Morin, or their combination for 14 weeks, followed by renal histological, biochemical, and metabolic evaluations. Morin reduced ROS accumulation, ER stress (p-PERK, p-eIF2alpha, CHOP, cleaved ATF6), mitochondrial dysfunction, and apoptosis in HK2 cells. It suppressed DAPK1 mRNA expression via ATF6 inhibition and directly bound DAPK1 (Kd = 1.61 mumol.L(-1)), disrupting its interaction with pro-apoptotic BAK/BIK. Empagliflozin indirectly downregulated DAPK1 through ER stress relief. Combination therapy synergistically reduced oxidative stress, preserved mitochondrial membrane potential, and prevented apoptosis. In db/db mice, both compounds improved renal structure, lowered blood glucose, reduced UACR, and inhibited kidney stress markers, with greater improvements in the combination group, which also alleviated hepatic steatosis. Morin exhibits renoprotective effects against high glucose-induced cellular stress and diabetic kidney disease, at least partially via DAPK1 targeting. Co-administration with Empagliflozin enhances these effects, supporting its potential as an adjunct therapy for hyperglycemia-induced kidney injury.
abstract_zh: 糖尿病肾病（DKD）是糖尿病的主要并发症，由高血糖诱导的氧化应激、内质网应激和线粒体凋亡驱动。本研究考察了桑色素（Morin）单独或与SGLT2抑制剂恩格列净（Empagliflozin）联合使用对高血糖诱导的肾小管损伤的保护作用，重点关注ATF6-DAPK1轴。HK2细胞暴露于高糖环境，并给予或不给予桑色素和/或恩格列净处理。评估了细胞应激、线粒体功能和凋亡。通过分子对接 (molecular docking)、表面等离子体共振 (surface plasmon resonance, SPR) 和细胞热位移分析 (cell thermal shift assay, CETSA) 检测了桑色素与DAPK1的结合。db/db小鼠接受载体、恩格列净、桑色素或其组合治疗14周，随后进行肾脏组织学、生化和代谢评估。桑色素减少了HK2细胞中ROS积累、内质网应激（p-PERK、p-eIF2alpha、CHOP、cleaved ATF6）、线粒体功能障碍和凋亡。它通过抑制ATF6而下调DAPK1 mRNA表达，并直接结合DAPK1（Kd = 1.61 μmol·L⁻¹），破坏其与促凋亡蛋白BAK/BIK的相互作用。恩格列净通过缓解内质网应激间接下调DAPK1。联合治疗协同减少氧化应激、维持线粒体膜电位并防止凋亡。在db/db小鼠中，两种化合物均改善了肾脏结构、降低了血糖、减少了UACR并抑制了肾脏应激标志物，联合组改善更为显著，同时还减轻了肝脏脂肪变性。桑色素通过靶向DAPK1至少部分发挥对高糖诱导的细胞应激和糖尿病肾病的肾脏保护作用。与恩格列净联合给药增强了这些效应，支持其作为高血糖诱导肾损伤辅助治疗的潜力。
